title: Active to Passive Voice: Rules and Verb Forms — Quiz 102A
content:
## Active to Passive Voice: Rules and Verb Forms

Review subject-object changes and passive verb forms across tenses.

### Lesson focus

1. Change the subject into the object and the object into the subject.
2. Use the third form of the main verb with the appropriate form of be.
3. Place by before the agent when it is needed.

### Practise with the image

Read the full lesson image for the original exercise, notes and any answer key shown. Write your own answers before checking a key. A key labelled for another quiz belongs to that quiz.
